story_zh: 我的邻居小李非常热情。他的爱好是音乐和体育。春天，他几乎每天锻炼，喜欢爬山和骑自行车。夏天，他参加音乐比赛，弹吉他极好听。秋天，他画可爱的鸟和马的照片。冬天，他努力玩游戏，照相机里有很多节日礼物。我对他的爱好很感兴趣，这是个好机会学习新事物。
story_pinyin: Wǒ de línjū Xiǎo Lǐ fēicháng rèqíng. Tā de àihào shì yīnyuè hé tǐyù. Chūntiān, tā jīhū měitiān duànliàn, xǐhuān páshān hé qí zìxíngchē. Xiàtiān, tā cānjiā yīnyuè bǐsài, tán jítā jí hǎotīng. Qiūtiān, tā huà kě'ài de niǎo hé mǎ de zhàopiàn. Dōngtiān, tā nǔlì wán yóuxì, zhàoxiàngjī lǐ yǒu hěnduō jiérì lǐwù. Wǒ duì tā de àihào hěn gǎn xìngqù, zhè shì gè hǎo jīhuì xuéxí xīn shìwù.
story_en: My neighbor Xiao Li is very enthusiastic. His hobbies are music and sports. In spring, he exercises almost every day and enjoys mountain climbing and riding bicycles. In summer, he participates in music competitions and plays the guitar extremely well. In autumn, he draws photos of cute birds and horses. In winter, he works hard playing games, and there are many holiday gifts in his camera. I am very interested in his hobbies; it's a good opportunity to learn new things.
